data.content: Implemented self-authenticating Ed25519 GitHub outbox proposals. Proposal OID, repository/ref/expected old OID/sequence/generation/key lineage and every event hash are signed; clients can submit only immutable proposal refs, while verification returns the exact Actions promotion request. Schema v23 preserves multi-event sequences, published-but-unacknowledged OIDs, and original retry generations losslessly. Forgery, replay, cross-writer, rewrap, undeclared-object, rotation, changed-generation retry, migration, crash/lost-ack, and v0.17.6 fail-closed tests pass. Independent security review APPROVE. Definitive make sanity: 1351 main tests plus integrations, 95.19% coverage. Commit f7bf2152; PR #108.
